changelog: 🤖 Native Android Companion (Kotlin & Jetpack Compose): Purpose-built native Android client in `android/` providing deep OS integration alongside the supported PWA client

🔒 Native Lock-Screen Medical ID: Persistent `VISIBILITY_PUBLIC` notification displaying patient blood group, critical allergies, and 1-tap actions: Show Medical QR (over Keyguard), Call 108 Ambulance, and Call Contact

📊 Permitted Background Sensor Monitoring: Compliant Foreground Service monitoring 3-axis accelerometer/gyroscope at 20 Hz (<0.8% battery/day) with multi-stage physics detection for severe vehicular collisions and hard falls
🛡️ Transparent Safety Guardrails: Strictly enforces user safety by never silently sending SMS or auto-dialing 108; presents interactive 30s confirmation dialog before distress actions

📲 Android SMS Handoff: Pre-populates distress coordinates, GPS maps link, patient blood group, allergies, and Medical ID URL into the user's default SMS app via `ACTION_SENDTO` for manual human review and send
⏰ Reliable Doze-Proof Medication Alarms: Uses `AlarmManager.setExactAndAllowWhileIdle()` to guarantee timely local medicine reminders during deep sleep, restored on device reboot via `BOOT_COMPLETED`
🔘 Interactive Notification Actions: 1-tap 'Mark Taken' and 'Snooze 15m' directly from the notification shade, backed by AES-256 GCM `EncryptedSharedPreferences`
📡 Secure Backend Synchronization: Express/Firebase `/api/companion/*` endpoints for state sync, dose updates, telemetry delivery, and configuration
🌐 Seamless PWA Coexistence: Preserves the PWA as an independent supported client with cross-client deep links (`lifeguard://companion` and `https://lifeguard-azure.vercel.app/companion`)
